# Claude + AI Digest — 2026-08-13

## 1. Anthropic starts invisibly watermarking Claude's AI-generated text and signing generated files [New capability]
High confidence — corroborated across Forbes, Euronews, The Register, Search Engine Journal, and Interesting Engineering (Aug 11). Anthropic signed the EU AI Act's Article 50(2) Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content; Claude models launched in the EU on/after Aug 2, 2026 embed a machine-readable text watermark by default (claimed not to change meaning/quality/readability), with older models getting it during a transition period, and generated files can carry signed provenance. Rolled out worldwide, not EU-only. Caveat straight from Anthropic: a detected mark means Claude *processed* the content, not that it *authored* it — it can also appear on human writing Claude only edited or translated. No direct Brian tie-in, but relevant background if any of his projects (CWI AI, GLP APP, Shantry Bills) ever publish Claude-drafted text/marketing copy where provenance questions could come up.

## 2. The watermarking rollout is drawing real pushback [Claude buzz]
Verifiably notable, not just a stray complaint — Forbes' own headline framing is "the internet isn't happy," and The Register's coverage frames it as Anthropic making "a sop to the EU," with both outlets citing visible user reaction beyond routine feature coverage. Same underlying story as item 1, different angle: reach here is about the reaction, not the feature itself.

## 3. Claude Code shipped 2.1.228 through 2.1.231 since the last check [New capability]
Confirmed via the CHANGELOG (raw GitHub source), high confidence. Mostly reliability polish, but two items are worth flagging on their own: a fix for Remote Control's `/resume` leaking conversation data between sessions (security-relevant, not just a UX bug), and a security/labeling hardening pass on skills synced from claude.ai. Also in the batch: `claude remote-control --continue` got documented, plugin marketplace gained `command` sources for dynamic plugin resolution, and `ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions offline instead of showing them stale. Nothing here changes what Brian's own custom skills/subagents/Agent-SDK setup can do, but the skills-sync hardening is worth knowing if he ever pulls a skill down from claude.ai rather than authoring it locally.
